evidence.metadataRefresh: Scoped reading-continuity merge: actual visible batches, exact metric cleanup, stable sticky position, selected-item native transitions and separate global section direction. Existing brand and historical numeric status retained.
evidence.captureScope: Desktop/mid-entry/mobile image evidence supports layer correction and first-entry states. Full-page mobile capture includes not-yet-triggered offscreen reveal states; it is not a settled proof for every section. Use scroll/section captures for those states.
evidence.loading: All seven HTML routes use motion3 cache keys. Classic head assets/navigation.js registers pagereveal before defer assets/motion.js; reading-position.css and navigation.css follow shared motion styles.
evidence.performanceClaim: Use current-machine active traces, matching asset hashes and same-environment baseline; no generalized fixed-fps/device guarantee. No final A/B values asserted by this documentation merge.
evidence.numericWorkflowStatus: Historical static numeric workflow exception remains open/not-closed; neither this documentation refresh nor later motion evidence declares pipeline PASS.

continuityPerformance.scope: Local active wheel/touch simulations and same-environment baseline comparison; raw captures are local and ignored. Do not infer universal fixed fps. Navigation demo25fps is choreography evidence only.

layerOrder.invariant: Fixed frame is behind the intact masthead; only inner image moves. User motion-feedback overrides earlier comp layering.

narrative.overview:
以纸白、钴蓝与墨色建立中文具身智能社区的出版物气质。品牌字标与实际项目图承担识别，细分隔线、明确列宽和可读的中文正文承担结构；正文、项目与学术分享共享一套平面视觉语言。

用户明确选择 home-comp-2，并批准用原有四个项目素材替代视觉稿中的生成图。落地实现保留原素材内容：EGO 项目图仍是插画，不被包装成实拍。选定首页的具体版面属于 .impeccable/surfaces/home.md，不是所有新页面必须复制的模板。后续用户反馈明确否定照片切穿字标的层级；.impeccable/surfaces/motion-upgrade.md 与用户附图覆盖旧稿对应的叠放逻辑。
keyCharacteristics: 纸白底、钴蓝强调、墨色正文与细规则线。
凝缩英文品牌字标搭配清晰的中文无衬线正文。
真实项目图、独立阅读列与直接的文本链接。
平面排版；字标保持完整，动效在固定层级内组织首屏和阅读节奏。

rules.name: The Cobalt Signal Rule
rules.body: 钴蓝承担品牌、重要标题、可执行链接与重点数据；墨色和中性灰维持阅读层级。

rules.name: The Rules Before Panels Rule
rules.body: 用列宽、留白和一像素规则线组织内容，不用浮起的容器替代信息结构。

rules.name: The Real Source Rule
rules.body: 项目图片和学术内容沿用可追溯素材；不把生成图、假二维码或未确认数据写成新的事实背书。

dos: Do 使用已托管的 Noto Sans SC 中文字体与 Barlow Condensed 字标，保持中文和拉丁文各自清晰的层级。
Do 让项目照片、插画、学术信息保留原身份，并明确缺失的入群二维码。
Do 保持文本链接可见、焦点环明确，内容不依赖 React 岛才能访问。
Do 在小屏把阅读双栏收成单栏，保留所有正文与参会信息。
donts: Don't 用渐变字、光晕、阴影圆角卡片替代现有的平面出版物语言。
Don't 把首页巨型字标、照片裁切或具体首屏叙事当作每条路由的模板。
Don't 在正文层放置持续跟随鼠标的装饰；Threads 仅存在于加入区域，减少动态偏好与窄屏不运行。
Don't 猜造讲者照片、社交账号、二维码、会议链接或项目表现。
